podcast.body: This song achieved popularity as one of The Dead Milkmen's biggest hits, earning them exposure on MTV and radio. "Punk Rock Girl."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was featured as an example of a band using the term "punk rock" in its title, highlighting the direct cultural adoption of the genre's name. "The dead milkman with a song called punk rock girl."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
